children.innerHTML: We are auxiliary to the National and County Governments, working to alleviate human suffering and preserve life and dignity across all 47 counties.
Severe drought across the Arid and Semi-Arid Lands has left more than 2.12 million people facing acute food insecurity, with malnutrition rising among children under five.
Flooding is affecting 39 counties. Over 60,000 households affected and 12,700 displaced; 26 million early-warning SMS alerts dispatched to at-risk communities.
Become a member or a volunteer
Anyone willing to offer their time, skills or resources to support our humanitarian work.
Members have duly paid the stipulated KRCS membership fees, with distinct functions and privileges.
